subject.title: fix(sessions): bound AGENTS.md and prompt-input file reads with size cap

question: Should existing readable `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` files larger than 1 MiB be rejected on upgrade, and if so what explicit compatibility and user-warning behavior is acceptable?
rationale: Current `main` loads all readable project-context files, while the proposed fixed cap changes persisted repository behavior; selecting the permanent policy is not a mechanical repair decision.

options.title: Approve a bounded context contract
options.body: Keep a documented project-context cap, but define the upgrade-visible warning and add tests proving the selected behavior.

options.title: Preserve existing context behavior
options.body: Do not impose the 1 MiB context cutoff until a separately approved compatibility path exists; retain only a safely bounded prompt-input solution.

recommendation.title: Approve a bounded context contract
recommendation.body: Keep a documented project-context cap, but define the upgrade-visible warning and add tests proving the selected behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: A current-main owner for the session resource-loader and its context-loading contract should make this compatibility decision.
